items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I used to rent my drum from him for a dollar and a half a week.

ctx.x: Can you remember your first drum set that you got, what it was like, or real drums? No, no, no.

It was, I was playing about two or three years before I was able to get a set of drums. I used to rent my drum from a man called Dave Puykins. Oh, sure. You heard of Professor Dave Puykins. I used to rent my drum from him for a dollar and a half a week.
Did you take any lessons when you were a kid? No lessons. No lessons. No lessons. You, of course, were always left-handed then, so you just picked it up naturally that way? Just, just natural.
